name: GpuSpecTable::from_toml

test_list.description: Every hardware row requires an HTTPS source URL and retrieval date.
Unsupported versions, duplicate capabilities, invalid dates, and impossible resource limits fail.
A schema-valid sourced row is retrievable by capability.
The embedded reference table contains cited entries for CC 7.5, 8.0, 8.6, 8.7, 8.9, and 9.0.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: At most 1 MB TOML containing version 1 and sourced GPU rows.

output_description: A validated table keyed by compute capability.
